cases.question: average speed per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel,AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: how many readings per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel,COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: what was the highest wave height
cases.sql: SELECT MAX(wave_height) AS max_wave FROM telemetry

cases.question: average water temperature across the fleet
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(water_temp) AS avg_temp FROM telemetry

cases.question: minimum and maximum speed for each vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MIN(speed) AS min_speed, MAX(speed) AS max_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS ts, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '2 days' GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) ORDER BY ts

cases.question: max wave height per vessel per day
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day,vessel AS vessel,max(wave_height) AS max_wave FROM telemetry GROUP BY day,vessel ORDER BY day,vessel LIMIT 5000

cases.question: daily minimum and maximum water temperature
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, MIN(water_temp) AS min_temp, MAX(water_temp) AS max_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY day LIMIT 5000

cases.question: Aurora's average speed in 15-minute buckets over the last day
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '15 minutes', ts) AS bucket, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel='Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

cases.question: average wind per vessel in six-hour buckets
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '6 hour', ts) AS bucket,vessel AS series,avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY bucket,vessel ORDER BY bucket,series LIMIT 5000

cases.question: average speed by hour of day
cases.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ts) AS hour,AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour LIMIT 5000

cases.question: average wave height by day of the week
cases.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM ts) AS dow, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM ts) ORDER BY dow

cases.question: speed of Atlas every 10 minutes today
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', ts) AS ts, speed AS speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel='Atlas' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' ORDER BY ts LIMIT 5000

cases.question: water temperature trend for Aurora in the last week
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, avg(water_temp) AS temp FROM telemetry WHERE vessel='Aurora' AND ts>=TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

cases.question: which vessel was fastest on average in the last 24 hours
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: compare wave height of all vessels by hour over the last 12 hours
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS bucket, vessel AS series, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '12 hours' GROUP BY bucket, vessel ORDER BY bucket, vessel

cases.question: mean speed for the last 30 minutes in one-minute buckets
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS bucket, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '30 minutes' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

cases.question: Average wind from September 3 to September 5, 2026, hourly
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS ts, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-03 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-06 00:00:00' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts LIMIT 5000

cases.question: Average wave height for the last hour in one-minute buckets
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS bucket, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

cases.question: compare speed of Kestrel and Nomad by hour
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS ts, vessel AS vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel IN ('Kestrel','Nomad') GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts), vessel ORDER BY ts, vessel

cases.question: Compare vessel speed by hour over the last day excluding Aurora
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS ts, vessel AS vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' AND vessel <> 'Aurora' GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts), vessel ORDER BY ts, vessel

cases.question: how many readings had waves above 4 metres, per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, count(*) AS cnt FROM telemetry WHERE wave_height>4 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Hourly average speed for vessels north of latitude 50 in the last day
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS ts, vessel AS vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts), vessel ORDER BY ts, vessel

cases.question: Show hourly wind for Poseidon over the last 7 days
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS ts, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE vessel='Poseidon' AND ts>=TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

cases.question: in how many hours did Solstice see wind above 30 knots
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts)) AS cnt FROM telemetry WHERE vessel='Solstice' AND wind>30 AND ts>=TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '14 days'

cases.question: table of the 10 highest hourly average wave heights
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave FROM telemetry GROUP BY hour ORDER BY avg_wave DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: the three fastest vessels by average speed in the past 7 days
cases.sql: SELECT vessel,AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts>=TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54'-INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: which day had the strongest average wind
cases.sql: SELECT date(ts) AS day, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY date(ts) ORDER BY avg_wind DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel recorded the coldest water
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, water_temp AS temp FROM telemetry ORDER BY water_temp ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel got farthest east
cases.sql: SELECT vessel AS vessel, lon AS max_lon FROM telemetry ORDER BY lon DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: correlation between wind and speed per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, corr(wind,speed) AS corr_ws FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: difference between maximum and minimum water temperature per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, max(water_temp)-min(water_temp) AS temp_range FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Compare speed and wave height by hour over the last 7 days
cases.sql: SELECT bucket, metric, val FROM (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS bucket, 'speed' AS metric, AVG(speed) AS val FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS bucket, 'wave_height' AS metric, AVG(wave_height) AS val FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY bucket) ORDER BY bucket, metric

cases.question: Average ratio of wave height to wind speed per hour over the last day
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wave_height/wind) AS avg_ratio FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: average speed of each vessel in km/h over the last day
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(speed*1.852) AS avg_speed_kmh FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: average speed per vessel in the first week versus the second week
cases.sql: SELECT vessel,CASE WHEN ts<'2026-09-08' THEN 'Week1' ELSE 'Week2' END AS week,AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts>='2026-09-01' AND ts<'2026-09-15' GROUP BY vessel,week ORDER BY vessel,week

cases.question: latest position of every vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, ts, lat, lon FROM telemetry QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY vessel ORDER BY ts DESC) = 1 ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: where was Meridian yesterday
cases.sql: SELECT lat AS lat, lon AS lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel='Meridian' AND ts::date=DATE '2026-09-13' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: show all vessel tracks on a map
cases.sql:
-- view: map
SELECT ts, vessel AS series, lat AS lat, lon AS lon FROM telemetry LIMIT 5000

cases.question: how many readings were taken north of 50 degrees latitude, per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel,COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telemetry WHERE lat>50 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Aurora's average position per day
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, AVG(lat) AS lat, AVG(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel='Aurora' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

cases.question: average wave height per ves
cases.sql: SELECT vessel AS vessel, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: wind
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS ts,vessel AS series,AVG(wind) AS wind_avg FROM telemetry WHERE ts>=TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54'-INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

cases.question: speed last week
cases.sql: SELECT vessel AS series,AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts>=TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54'-INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel LIMIT 5000

cases.question: scatter of wind vs wave height
cases.sql:
-- view: scatter
SELECT wind AS wind, wave_height AS wave_height FROM telemetry LIMIT 5000
